name: P-H3-Image
description: Pruna AI's 8-step image model on MiniMax H3 of November 2026: instruction edits of the crop with up to eight more pictures, named <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> ..., and new pictures from the prompt, 1k to 4k. On WaveSpeedAI (your ComfyUI runs it with the P-H3-Image (ComfyUI) recipe, Comfy Cloud with P-H3-Image (Comfy Cloud)). Powered by MiniMax H3. P-H3-Image is under the MiniMax H3 Community License, which does not cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the US without a separate licence from MiniMax (platform.minimax.io/h3-license). Adapter written from the provider's docs, not run against the live API yet.

wavespeed.note: Instruction edit of the crop (<Picture 1>) plus the reference layers (<Picture 2> ...), no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. The edit answers in the crop's shape (WaveSpeed's aspect follows the first picture); a new image takes the preset closest to the canvas. Resolution 2k is about 4 MP, the edit size Pruna AI advises. WaveSpeed's schema has no prompt upsampler and no negative prompt. Per image: an edit $0.03 at 1k, $0.045 at 1.5k, $0.06 at 2k, $0.12 at 3k, $0.18 at 4k, plus $0.005 for each picture after the first; a new image $0.02, $0.03, $0.04, $0.08, $0.12 (WaveSpeed, 2026-11-06). Not run against the live API yet (written from WaveSpeed's schema, 2026-11-06).
